title: nan
authors: Klein K.T.J.; Uysal F.; Cuenca M.C.; Otten M.P.G.; De Wit J.J.M.
key_contribution: Presents a radar-aided navigation system fusing mmWave radar and IMU for small drones operating in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
